admission.justification: Weakening notes selector and path confinement could expose files outside the admitted series, while changing named refusal states could make callers misread access failures as note content.

applicability: The {repo, master} selector validation and status mapping in _notes_response, shared by the folder, resolve, text-read and bytes notes routes; the three JSON routes delegate through _notes_json. Also applies to the size-capped binary-tolerant note read (read_note).
conditions: The repository comes from the MCP settings allow-list and master is a single path segment.
exclusions: The listing walk's own classification of entries, which the byte-identity clause covers.
statement: Unknown repo answers 404 unknown-repo, a multi-segment master 400 bad-request, traversal and symlink-escape reads 400 bad-path, a missing note 404 not-found, and an undecodable note reads as language binary.
